I am a computational neuroscientist at the [Frankfurt Institute for Advanced Studies (FIAS)](https://fias.institute).
I study how the developing cortex organises itself: how spontaneous activity,
recurrent connectivity and experience shape the functional maps that emerge
in early life.

My work combines mathematical models of recurrent networks with analyses of
experimental data from developing visual cortex.

## Interests

- Cortical development and self-organisation
- Recurrent network models of the visual cortex
- Variability and learning in neural circuits
- Teaching and interactive scientific tools
